newsitem.title: CHINA: China to assign supervisors to exchanges.
newsitem.headline: China to assign supervisors to exchanges.

text.p: China's securities regulator will assign supervisors to securities and futures exchanges shortly to improve supervision, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday.

The supervisors would track the exchanges' operations, follow market trends, supervise their business, finance and settlement systems and report back to the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the newspaper said.

In a commentary on Friday to explain the move, the official China Securities newspaper said China's securities markets were developing very quickly this year, and this had prompted the need for stricter supervision.

"Quick development of the securities markets is needed for the country's economic development," it said. "The hotter the markets, the more it is necessary to strengthen supervision. The assignment of supervisors will help improve the supervisory system of the markets."
